findings.summary: A fresh rejection of a source column, a referenced column, any member of a composite foreign key, or either side of a self-reference removes that relationship from effective and queues relationship_endpoint_not_effective. The detail is from_column_not_effective, to_column_not_effective, or from_and_to_column_not_effective. The item is pending and publishable false. Generated evidence, the curated echo, and the historical decision stay. An accept does not restore the column. A stale decision removes nothing. A human rejection of the relationship adds no endpoint item. Every effective foreign key in the probe names an effective dataset and effective columns.
